entities.name: Francisco Luís da Silva Campos
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Francisco Luiz da Silva Campos was a Brazilian jurist, educator, legal scholar, politician, cabinet minister, supporter of Getúlio Vargas, and justice minister under Vargas's authoritarian Estado Novo government. Campos is best known as the author of the 1937 Constitution of Brazil.

entities.name: Francisco Luís da Silva Campos
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Francisco Luiz da Silva Campos was a Brazilian jurist, educator, legal scholar, politician, cabinet minister, supporter of Getúlio Vargas, and justice minister under Vargas's authoritarian Estado Novo government. Campos is best known as the author of the 1937 Constitution of Brazil.
